an9.62:3.1: khemo → khemā dve amatā dve (bj) | amatañceva abhayaṁ passaddhiyena ca → dve bhayā passaddhiyā duve (bj) | amatañceva abhayaṁ passaddhiyena → amataṁ ceva abhayapassaddhiyena (sya-all)
an9.62:3.3: ca dhammaṁ pahāya bhabbena → ceva dhammaṁpahāyabhabbena (sya-all)
an9.62:3.4:
bhabbābhabbenekādasāti → khemo ca amataṁ ceva abhayaṁ passaddhiyena ca
nirodho anupubbo ceva dhammaṁ pahāya bhabbena cāti – sīmu (bj note)
